title: SMOOTH FIRST SWING CHECK-IN
description: The update spends credibility in one place and tries to earn it back somewhere else. The opening combat pass now lets attacks cancel cleanly into dodge, loot pickup, and the inevitable tutorial popover. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: Players blamed themselves for failure instead of the input queue, which design marked as a milestone. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.

title: SMOOTH FIRST SWING BREATHER
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. The opening combat pass now lets attacks cancel cleanly into dodge, loot pickup, and the inevitable tutorial popover. Daily chores have been shortened so players can leave before the evening becomes a second job.
consequence: Players blamed themselves for failure instead of the input queue, which design marked as a milestone. Engagement dipped, but so did the farewell essays.

title: COMMITTED INTERACTION TIMING PILOT
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Gathering, crafting, and chest opening now include deliberate windups to make the world feel physically expensive. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: Every common action gained weight. Most of it landed on the player's patience. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.
